name: i18n pre-check - MCP server
description: Shared read-only MCP server for the i18n skills: Lokalise, GitHub, shared learnings (read + append-only), report upload (create-only). Jira, Confluence, Figma via each user's own connectors. Bearer auth.

parameters.instructions: Shared data layer for the team's i18n skills. Reads only Lokalise (projects, English source, translations, shared glossary) and GitHub (repo tree, files, PR diff) with read-only credentials, and never writes to them. Two writes, both create/append-only: create_workbook_upload_link (a new report in SHARED COMPANY FOLDER I18N/AI AUDITS, rename on conflict, never overwrites) and add_shared_learnings (appends reviewed decisions to the shared learnings table; cannot edit or delete). Everything else personal goes through the user's own connectors: Confluence product pages and Jira bugs/Tasks through their Atlassian connector, Figma through their Figma connector. Typical run: get_shared_learnings -> get_repo_tree / get_pr_diff -> get_repo_files (batches of 150) -> list_lokalise_projects + get_en_source (compare keys_seen with keys_total) -> get_shared_glossary -> get_translation_lengths -> workbook -> create_workbook_upload_link -> PUT the file. After the person reviews the workbook: add_shared_learnings.

parameters.description: List the source files of a GitHub repo at a branch (read-only): returns ref, default_branch, tree_truncated and files [{path, size}] already filtered to code, templates and locale files (no node_modules, tests, builds). Leave ref empty for the default branch. Owner defaults to QR-CODE-App.

parameters.description: Read the raw contents of up to 150 files from a GitHub repo (read-only). Pass paths as a JSON array string taken from get_repo_tree, and the ref it returned. Returns files [{path, content}] plus missing paths. Call again for the next batch of 150.

value.ref: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('ref', 'Branch or commit, as returned by get_repo_tree') }}
value.paths: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('paths', 'JSON array string of file paths, max 150') }}

parameters.description: Read a GitHub pull request (read-only): title, state, head_ref, base_ref, changed_files and the unified .diff, so the check can report changed lines only. Use head_ref with get_repo_tree / get_repo_files for full-file context.

For the Figma fit check (read-only, Lokalise): pass the frontend Lokalise project id, the locales (comma-separated codes) and the Figma texts as a JSON array string. Returns matches {EN text: {key, plural, t: {locale: translation}}} for real lengths, en_values (all EN values, for new-copy and copy-drift checks), keys_seen and not_in_project. Archived keys are excluded.

value.strings: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('strings', 'JSON array string of the Figma texts to look up') }}

parameters.description: List every Lokalise project with project_id, name, keys_total and base language (read-only). Use it to resolve a project name to its id and to check get_en_source completeness.

Read the English source keys of one Lokalise project (read-only, archived keys excluded): rows {key_id, k, en, description, plural, tags}. Used for the unused and obsolete keys check. Compare keys_seen with keys_total from list_lokalise_projects.

parameters.content:
## Shared i18n read server (READ ONLY)

Lokalise + GitHub reads only, on read-only credentials. No personal credentials here: Jira, Confluence, OneDrive and Figma are read by each user through their own connectors.
Never attach a tool that writes anywhere.

parameters.description: Read the shared Lokalise glossary live (read-only): product and brand names, forbidden and non-translatable terms, with their descriptions and translations. Fetch it on every run, never from a cache.

Get a short-lived, pre-authenticated OneDrive upload URL for a NEW report file in SHARED COMPANY FOLDER I18N/AI AUDITS/<product>. Pass product as the exact product folder name (BrainIQtest, Chat AI, LoveStyle, Mindspree, Mobitrace, My Image, My QR Code, MyWapp, PDFhelp, Personality, QRcreate, RealChecker, ResumeWise, UniCopy, VinReady); anything else goes to AI AUDITS itself. Create-only: on a name clash the new file is renamed; nothing is ever overwritten, moved or deleted. Then PUT the bytes to upload_url (Content-Length and Content-Range: bytes 0-<size-1>/<size>, no Authorization header); the PUT response has the final name and webUrl.

value.product: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('product', 'Product folder, exactly one of: BrainIQtest, Chat AI, LoveStyle, Mindspree, Mobitrace, My Image, My QR Code, MyWapp, PDFhelp, Personality, QRcreate, RealChecker, ResumeWise, UniCopy, VinReady. Empty string if none fits (file goes to AI AUDITS)') }}

parameters.description: Read the SHARED learnings of every i18n-readiness run, by anyone (read-only): reviewed decisions with reasons, kept in SHARED COMPANY FOLDER I18N/AI AUDITS/i18n readiness learnings.xlsx. Call it at the start of every run, before building findings. Pass the product name (e.g. 'Chat AI', 'VinReady'); returns that product's Active learnings plus every Global one (empty product = all). Skip or downgrade findings that match a Rejected learning and say so in the report; follow any Rule.

value.product: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('product', 'Product name, e.g. Chat AI. Empty string for all products') }}

parameters.description: APPEND-ONLY: add reviewed decisions to the shared learnings table so every future run, by anyone, learns from them. Call it when the person comes back after reviewing a workbook ('read the sheet'): one row per Rejected row that has a reason, and per Approved row whose pattern is worth remembering. rows = JSON array string, max 50, each {product, check, finding_pattern, decision: 'Rejected'|'Approved', reason, decided_by, source_workbook}. finding_pattern describes the kind of finding in general words (not a one-off cell), so it can match future findings. Rows are always stored as Scope=Product, Status=Active; only Maria promotes to Global or retires. Cannot edit or delete anything.

value.rows: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('rows', 'JSON array string of learnings: [{product, check, finding_pattern, decision (Rejected or Approved), reason, decided_by, source_workbook}], max 50') }}
